name: FUN_AV_METADATA_DETAIL
description: To store all the metadata detailed information about created analytical view. This table will be used internally by av consumption layer

columns.name: AV_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated analytic view identifier

columns.name: AV_NAME
columns.description: Autogenerated name for the analytic view.

columns.name: SOURCE_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: View name for the star schema created on top of the FND tables.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Value set identifier for the tree code definition."

columns.name: SEGMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of dimension. Valid values are COA for chart of accounts, T for time, L for ledger, LS for ledger set, C for currency, H for hierarchy, M for measures, and CM for calculated measure.

columns.name: DIMENSION_NAME
columns.description: User Interface dimension name used to display in the UI.

columns.name: DIMENSION_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: The sequence number for displaying the dimension.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_DIMENSION_NAME
columns.description: Name for the attribute dimension

columns.name: DIMENSION_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Column names for the attribute dimension.

columns.name: DIMENSION_LEVEL_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Additional column names for the attribute dimension.

columns.name: DIMENSION_LEVEL_DESCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Description column names for attribute dimension

columns.name: HIERARCHY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the hierarchy used in the analytic view.

columns.name: UI_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the dimension displays in the user interface. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_HIERARCHY_NAME
columns.description: User-defined name for the hierarchy.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Column names for the hierarchy.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_PRIOR_STATE
columns.description: Prior state of the tree version. Valid values are Active, Draft and InActive.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_CURRENT_STATE
columns.description: Current state of the tree version. Valid values are Active, Draft and InActive.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_NOMINATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tree version is nominated for inclusion in the analytic view. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_STREAMING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a tree version is eligible for streaming or not. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the tree version.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the tree version.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version identifier for the hierarchy.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
